methodology: Actual production extraction, revision-bound organization, two production retrieval/QA entries, and isolated automatic post-hoc stages. Unedited ready proposals are confirmed only in isolated evaluation workspaces. Gold appears only in post-hoc judges. Anonymous paired answer scoring uses the same generating model, not independent validation. The previously examined 80 held-out questions are fixed regressions, not unseen blind evaluation. Paragraph control skips extraction and is diagnostic only.

offlineReplay.methodology: Offline replay of all 2104 memory candidates in 102 complete v4 extraction receipts. Candidate classification calls current Rust ai::checked_candidate and memory_facts::extraction_check. No model calls, document imports, candidate confirmations, database mutations, or gold answers. Categories are disjoint and do not measure semantic correctness. Old 6000-character response batches are not rerun: v5 quantity overflow is reported separately, so per-candidate ready does not mean these old batches would be accepted by v5.

saturation.note: Counts overlap. Exactly reaching a cap is a saturation signal, not proof of omitted facts or truncation; raw complete responses include parents later split or rejected.

organization.note: Validation acceptance and source substring matches are not semantic assertion precision. Scope-needs-review drafts remain outside formal memory.

retainedMemoryContent.methodology: Isolated same-model judge sees formal memory CONTENT only, not retrieval or final answers; yes/partial/no/uncertain are automatic estimates.

pairedComparison.methodology: Same frozen questions. Current and baseline final answers are graded anonymously in the same isolated answer-judge call when pairedGrade is true. Legacy grades remain visible for scoring-drift audit. All answerable questions remain in denominators, errors and missing judgments never count as correct. Memory retention judge does not see retrieval or answers and sees only formal content, never provenance quotes. Automatic same-model estimates; no independent human review. Prior 80 held-out questions are now fixed regression cases, not unseen blind evaluation.

historicalBaselineMatched.methodology: Mutually exclusive observed loss, not causal proof. All answerable cases stay in accuracy denominators; missing/uncertain judges never count as correct. Answer correctness is same-model post-hoc judgment, not independently validated. Joint judge memory/retrieval labels were found confounded and excluded from stage attribution. Paragraph control attribution uses actual gold paragraph links/full text. Missing one gold set does not prove no equivalent evidence existed, and whole paragraph visibility does not prove sufficient reading. Organization errors are not separately blamed without evidence from facet ablation.
